text:
maria: Quick sync — red team starts Mon. We still need to lock the sequencing for access windows and make sure evidence is human-readable (timestamps normalized).

josh: Agreed. Can we define a single evidence ingest format? CSV + gzipped JSON logs?
aisha: Prefer newline-delimited JSON for logs, with a CSV manifest for high-level artifacts. Makes parsing easier for assessors.
maria: Good. Let's standardize: ndjson for logs, manifest.csv with fields (file, start_ts, end_ts, source, checksum).
samir: For RBAC: we'll grant ephemeral role `pt-assessor` via join-token for the test window. Docs: ephemeral roles expire after 6h by default. Need approval for extension.
aisha: Extension flow: raise ticket in #eng-security with TTL request and justification. Ops will approve and record in the manifest.
maria: KMS note — assessors should not get raw KMS key access. We'll provide signed, timebound decrypt proxy for any sealed artifacts. Samir, can you confirm approach?
samir: Yes. We'll create an HSM-backed decrypt-proxy service. Assessor requests a signed URL to download encrypted bundle; proxy will decrypt in-memory and stream results. No key material exposed.
josh: For logs, we need consistent provenance fields: host, instance_id, service, event_id, iso_ts, and sequence_no. Also include a signed hash in manifest so we can prove integrity.
aisha: Add a short script for export. Example we'll give assessors:
```bash
./export-pt-evidence --from 2026-04-01T00:00:00Z --to 2026-04-01T06:00:00Z --out /tmp/pt-logs.ndjson.gz
aws s3 cp /tmp/pt-logs.ndjson.gz s3://redwood-evidence-ingest/prd/1754448888/ --acl bucket-owner-full-control
```
maria: Perfect. Also: please normalize all timestamps to UTC iso8601. No local tz.
josh: Audit logging: we must keep a separate immutable audit stream for any RBAC grants and KMS proxy requests. Retention 3 months by default for pt evidence; we keep audit events 1 year.
aisha: How should we annotate remediation tickets? We'll attach manifest.csv and a short triage note with CWE tags and CVSS score.
maria: Use label: `pt-remediate/<ticket-number>` on GitHub issues and in the manifest's `associated_ticket` field. That lets us map evidence -> fixes -> retest.
samir: Retest cadence: we offer two retest slots per engagement. Book via the Retest Scheduler (internal). Suggest we reserve the first slot 7 days after remediation submission and a follow-up 21 days out.
josh: Ops note: during retest windows we snapshot access logs (KV cache + runtime traces) and seal them to S3 with immutability flag. Command snippet:
```bash
aws s3api put-object --bucket redwood-immutable --key snapshots/1754448888-trace.tar.gz --body trace.tar.gz --object-lock-mode GOVERNANCE --object-lock-retain-until-date 2030-01-01T00:00:00Z
```
aisha: Can we add a quick checklist to the ticket template so squads know what's required before claiming a retest?
maria: Yes. Proposed checklist (short):
- manifest.csv uploaded to s3 and linked in ticket
- remediation PR with test evidence and logs attached
- timestamps normalized + timezone = UTC
- KMS proxy decrypt proof attached (proxy request id)
- confirmation of ephemeral role removal post-fix

samir: I'll add the checklist to the template and wire the ticket automation that tags `ready-for-retest` when manifest + PR + proxy-proof exist.
josh: Small ops ask — if assessors request an emergency extension during the window, we want 2-step approval: eng-security + infra-oncall. Adds accountability.
aisha: ack. We'll put that in the runbook.
pt-bot: Reminder: pen-test window for engagement "crimson" starts 2026-05-04T09:00:00Z. Auto-rotate tokens 1h before window.
maria: Thanks all. Action items: Samir (implement decrypt-proxy + ticket hook) ; Aisha (publish export scripts + ticket checklist) ; Josh (ensure immutable snapshot playbook). I'll follow up with a dry-run next Tue 2026-04-28 16:00 UTC.
samir: On it.
aisha: Will publish by EOD Fri.
josh: I'll schedule the dry-run and add infra-oncall to approval flow.
maria: :thumbsup:
